description: Add the Email section to the provider EHR UI: a sidebar nav entry and page route in app/ehr/full-production-interface.tsx, plus a standalone client component app/ehr/email-inbox.tsx (EmailPage) that lists the inbox, opens a message with sanitized content, and composes/replies — all against the FEAT-002 routes, styled to match the existing EHR. Mirrors the existing app/ehr/fax-inbox.tsx precedent. Depends on FEAT-002 (routes must exist). Build signal is the Amplify job for the commit.
steps: In app/ehr/full-production-interface.tsx, add Mail to the lucide-react import block (near the other icon imports ~lines 36-64).

Insert ['email','Email',Mail] into the providerItems array immediately after the ['messages','Messages',MessageSquare] entry (~line 1367), then renumber every groups .slice() boundary that comes after the Communication group so the positional grouping still partitions correctly (the groups array ~lines 1381-1389 uses providerItems.slice(9,11) for Communication, slice(11,14) for Billing & Review, etc. — inserting one item shifts each later index by +1). Verify by eye that every nav item still appears exactly once across the groups.

In PageRouter() add the dispatch line: if (page === 'email' && currentUser.role === 'provider') return <EmailPage />; placed beside the other provider dispatches (~line 1502). Import EmailPage from './email-inbox' at the top with the other local imports.

Create app/ehr/email-inbox.tsx as a 'use client' default-export EmailPage, mirroring app/ehr/fax-inbox.tsx: useEffect loads /api/ehr/email/inbox with { credentials:'same-origin', cache:'no-store' } into state with loading/error handling; clicking an item fetches /api/ehr/email/inbox?id=<key> and shows from/subject/date and the sanitized text (render html only via the sanitized string the API returns, as text or a carefully set container — do not introduce dangerouslySetInnerHTML of unsanitized content); a compose/reply form with To, Subject, and a Textarea POSTs JSON to /api/ehr/email/send and shows the returned status; pre-fill To/Subject (Re:) and inReplyTo when replying to an open message. Use the same Tailwind class vocabulary as fax-inbox.tsx (rounded-2xl border bg-white p-5 cards, rounded-lg border buttons) so it matches the EHR Card/Button/Input/Textarea look.
Keep the section provider-only (the route already gates to owner/provider; the nav item lives in providerItems which only renders for role provider).
acceptance_criteria: The Amplify build for the pushed commit succeeds (next build green).
The provider EHR sidebar shows an 'Email' item under the Communication group, and every other nav item still renders exactly once (no missing/duplicated section from the slice renumbering).
Selecting Email renders the inbox from /api/ehr/email/inbox; opening a message shows its sanitized content; composing or replying POSTs to /api/ehr/email/send and surfaces the result.
No message body text is written to console; fetches use credentials:'same-origin'.
verification: Commit on aws-ehr-production and confirm the Amplify deploy job is green (the build signal; no local tsc).

In the deployed EHR as the provider/owner, open the Email section, load the inbox, open a delivered message, and send a test email; confirm each works and that all other sidebar sections still appear correctly.
findings:
UI changes implemented in commit 75f1e0b1d30eae7fb16df04bfbe0eec610f13dba on branch aws-ehr-production. (1) Added Mail to the lucide-react import block in app/ehr/full-production-interface.tsx. (2) Inserted ['email','Email',Mail] into providerItems immediately after the ['messages','Messages',MessageSquare] entry (new index 11, 22 items total). Renumbered the groups .slice() boundaries for every group after Communication: Communication slice(9,12) now covers telehealth/messages/email; Billing & Review slice(12,15); Wellness tools slice(15,19); Practice resources slice(19,21); Provider training slice(21). Verified by index that all 22 providerItems are partitioned exactly once with no gaps or duplicates. (3) Added PageRouter dispatch: if (page === 'email' && currentUser.role === 'provider') return <EmailPage />; and imported EmailPage from './email-inbox'. (4) Created app/ehr/email-inbox.tsx ('use client' default-export EmailPage) mirroring fax-inbox.tsx: useEffect loads /api/ehr/email/inbox with credentials:'same-origin', cache:'no-store' into state with loading/error handling and cursor paging; opening an item fetches /api/ehr/email/inbox?id=<key> and shows from/subject/date; renders text as a <pre>, falling back to the API's already-sanitized html string (lib/ehr/inbound-email.ts sanitizeHtml) via a single dangerouslySetInnerHTML only on that sanitized string; a compose/reply form with To/Subject/Textarea POSTs JSON to /api/ehr/email/send and surfaces the returned status; Reply pre-fills To=from, Subject='Re: ...', and inReplyTo=messageId. Uses the same Tailwind vocabulary (rounded-2xl border bg-white p-5 cards, rounded-lg border buttons). No message body text is logged to console. Provider-only: the route gates owner/provider and the nav item lives in providerItems (provider role only).
